notes.title: Play USBB with Steam Remote Play Together
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33591918/bb91a7e58e9d9d2fdf0d420e8290e3248d5c9c35.png

"I want to play this game with my friends, but they're so far away..."

"Will there be online multiplayer for this game?"

GOOD NEWS FROM STEAM!
Now in Beta! you can now invite up to 3 Steam Friends to join your Ultra Space Battle Brawl game online. Only the host needs to own and install the game, while additional players connect through Steam Remote Play streaming technology.

HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH IT!

 Play USBB with Steam Friends online
 Stream video, audio, input, and voice between players
 Use your own controllers, or share control of the keyboard & mouse
 Play together across PC and Mac


HOW DOES IT WORK?
1. Launch your game. Join Steam Beta, then launch any of your local multiplayer games.

2. Invite your friends. From your Friends list in the Steam Overlay, select Remote Play Together. Once they accept...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33591918/51f7d510ece51936360460c0ce4d36c23616bf7c.gif

3. You're playing together.


Their controllers will act as if they're plugged directly into your computer, and all your voice chat and game volume options are available in one place. You can share — or limit access to — the keyboard and mouse. It’s your choice.

Go to the link below to learn more about Steam Remote Play Together!
steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687

Now invite your friends and get ready to SMASH!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/658500/Ultra_Space_Battle_Brawl/

notes.title: Want to play USBB with your friends online? Here's five steps to do it (number 5 will surprise you)
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33591918/608b10ff998269f3e5582672c343f0fee35db15c.gif

Hello Everyone!

First of all, everyone at Mojiken Studio wants to express our deepest gratitude for all of you. It was a roller coaster ride to get to this point, but we can make it because of your support. So once again, thank you.

We also want to talk about something that has been requested by many of the gamers that have given USBB a try, and that thing is online multiplayer.

We always hoped to bring online multiplayer mode to USBB. Since our initial prototype, we think that this kind of fighting/competitive game has to have an online mode where you can invite your friends to play even when you're alone at home. But sadly, some limitations from the technical standpoint, resources, and time made that a bit too hard to pull while maintaining our sanity.

Luckily for PC and Mac user, there's a workaround to enjoy USBB with your friends online, thanks to the wonderful technology called Parsec!
Parsec lets you stream a game, and have friends watch and play along with their controllers. It's quick and easy to set up, and it's also free if you host the game from your computer.

How to play:
[olist]
Download the client from  http://parsecgaming.com
Run the application and create an account. Get your friends to do the same
If you want to host, click "Add A Computer." In the setting, you can set what apps your friends can see/control too
To join a friend, add them using their Parsec username and request to Co-Play
Run the game, and you can play with your friends online like they're sitting next to you!
[/olist]

If you have any issues with Parsec, chat them on their discord channel here.

Lastly, we hope you enjoy the game and keep supporting us. Join our discord channel to say hi and maybe find friends to play USBB together.

Thank you so much! You folks are awesome!
